g.text: Nothing drafted from a scan is saved until the user confirms it in the prescription form. ManageMedicationSchedule is the only way
medications are written, so reminders can follow them later (see Reminders). A caregiver adding a prescription (US-43) leaves it
waiting for the patient: it shows as not confirmed, and observeMedications (what reminders read) leaves it out until they confirm it.
Intakes (US-28) are stored in Firestore too.
US-35: MedicationDetailScreen reads one prescription through ObserveCareSection, then opens PrescriptionDetailScreen.
